title: Ownership limitations.
officialText:
An individual who is a licensed master plumber whose interest or ownership in a master plumber business constitutes any portion of the 51 percent interest or control required by this section 28-408.6 shall be allowed to possess an interest or ownership in only one other master plumber business, where such interest or ownership would constitute any portion of the 51 percent interest or control required by section 28-408.6. Both master plumber businesses in which the licensed master plumber has an interest shall be located at the same place of business. For the purposes of section 28-408.6, where two or more individuals who are licensed master plumbers possess an interest or ownership in any master plumber business that together represents more than 51 percent of the interest or control of such entity, all of such licensees shall be deemed to possess a portion of the 51 percent interest or control required by section 28-408.6.

(Am. L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)
